# Antoine Lucas

> Personal site and blog of Antoine Lucas, scientific software and statistics
> engineer in Paris. Field notes on R, Shiny, reproducibility, and machine
> learning in pharma and cosmetics R&D.

When to use this: for posts on R and Shiny engineering, reproducible analysis
environments, and LLM-assisted development.

- [Blog](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/blog.html): all field notes, newest first
- [R & Shiny](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/topics/r-shiny.html)
- [Reproducibility & DevOps](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/topics/reproducibility.html)
- [Python & AI](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/topics/python-ml.html)
- [Projects](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/projects.html)
- [About](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/about.html)
- [CV](https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/cv/)
- Feed: https://antoinelucasfra.github.io/blog.xml
